panels.title: node-baml · BAML heap slots
panels.description: Counters from baml.sys.heap_stats() in the serving runtime. Runtime slots include unused reservations and uncollected objects. Counts are gauges, not bytes or live-object counts; separately allocated payloads are excluded. Each scrape allocates a BAML result and does not force GC.
